issue: Orders purchased outside the analysis window (thin months at both ends)
customer_id is created per order; one person can have several
Orders with more than one review
decision: Keep the latest review per order

issue: review_id values that appear on more than one order
decision: Never join on review_id; key reviews by (review_id, order_id)

issue: Delivered in-window orders where items + freight differ from total paid by more than 0.01
decision: Revenue uses item prices; mismatches left unexplained and listed as a limitation

issue: Orders with status delivered but no customer delivery date
Orders with status canceled that have a customer delivery date
decision: Kept as canceled; not used for delivery timing

issue: Products whose category has no English translation
decision: Fall back to the Portuguese name

issue: Source columns spelled lenght instead of length
decision: Raw table unchanged; v_products exposes corrected names

issue: Timed in-window orders with a negative stage duration
decision: Excluded from stage statistics only; reported as a limitation

issue: Second delivered orders placed on the same calendar day as the first
decision: A repeat customer is one who returned on a later calendar day

issue: Geolocation rows that exactly duplicate another row
decision: v_geo averages distinct points, one row per zip prefix

issue: Customer zip prefixes with no geolocation row
decision: Orders without coordinates left out of distance analysis

issue: Orders with no order_items rows (all statuses, all dates)
decision: Drop out of item-level analysis naturally; kept in status counts
